title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the Apps edit permission could cause Splunk SOAR to…
description: Splunk SOAR versions prior to 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where users with the Apps edit permission role can trigger arbitrary code execution on the host by validating an installed app. This occurs because the app validation process does not properly isolate untrusted code from the trusted environment, allowing malicious code execution.
